annotations.text:
"Give your AI agent GTM superpowers." ('your AI agent' in pink, no rotation). Built from the Figma GTM Landing Page hero (node 4197-9774): cream #FBF6F1, stacked-circle rainbow, nav, dark primary button; secondary button uses the light chrome fill.
Agent marks: Claude, OpenAI (for Codex), OpenClaw, Grok (for GrokBot), Hermes (H from the pixel wordmark), all in plum.
H1 face: Figma uses Aeonik Condensed Pro 600; Aeonik Bold stands in at the same size and tracking.
Kept for reference: the Figma two-column hero with the new copy, and three earlier drafts on the old kit with alternative H1s.

Rebuilt after the critique (2026-09-11): real responsive layout (fluid gutters, breakpoints 1216/1100/1024/900/767, mobile hero recomposition like the live site), balanced markup, real links, semantic sections, calmer motion (one-shot demos, JS-timed name rotation, chat that grows at reading pace, one play at a time in the org chart, brain hubs on a fixed ring with write-back pulses), reduced-motion honoured. Copy untouched. Site build: external WOFF2 fonts + avatar files, 126 KB HTML.
